name: Preisänderungen mit Kundensonderpreisen
description: Gruppiert Einkaufspreisänderungen nach Artikel und führt darunter die zugehörigen Kundensonderpreise auf.
export_instructions: Zuerst in SilverERP Controlling / Gesp. Abfragen / Preise öffnen und die Liste als CSV exportieren. Nach der Berichtsauswahl zusätzlich den Export für EK Sonderpreise aus Gespeicherte Abfragen hochladen.
query:
WITH prepared AS (
        SELECT *,
          CAST(`Zeitpunkt` AS BIGINT) AS silver_timestamp,
          (CAST(`Zeitpunkt` AS DOUBLE) - 7900000000000) / 1000000000 AS x
        FROM data
        WHERE `Typ` = 'supplierArticle'
      ), changed_articles AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT `Artikel-Nr.` FROM prepared
      ), combined AS (
        SELECT
          `Artikel-Nr.` AS artnr,
          `Bezeichnung 1` AS bezeichnung,
          0 AS row_type,
          silver_timestamp AS row_time,
          'EK-Änderung' AS eintrag,
          `Referenz` AS bezug,
          STRFTIME(
            TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00'
              + (14.2926176 * POWER(x, 4) + 1546.80544 * POWER(x, 3) - 26762.5368 * POWER(x, 2) + 7762978.55 * x + 669577867) * INTERVAL '1 second',
            '%d.%m.%Y %H:%M'
          ) || chr(10) || `Benutzer` AS zeit_benutzer,
          REPLACE(PRINTF('%.4f', CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)), '.', ',') || chr(10) || REPLACE(PRINTF('%.4f', CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) * 1.11), '.', ',') AS preis_alt_ek,
          REPLACE(PRINTF('%.4f', CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)), '.', ',') || chr(10) || REPLACE(PRINTF('%.4f', CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) * 1.11), '.', ',') AS preis_neu_kunde,
          CASE
            WHEN CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN '–'
            ELSE REPLACE(PRINTF('%+.2f %%', (CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) / CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) - 1) * 100), '.', ',')
          END AS abweichung,
          CASE
            WHEN CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) > CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) THEN 'up'
            WHEN CAST(REPLACE(`Preis neu`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) < CAST(REPLACE(`Preis`, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) THEN 'down'
            ELSE 'same'
          END AS richtung
        FROM prepared
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          s.`Artikel-Nr.` AS artnr,
          s.`Beschreibung 1` AS bezeichnung,
          1 AS row_type,
          NULL AS row_time,
          'Kundensonderpreis' AS eintrag,
          '[' || s.`Kunden-Nr.` || '] ' || s.`Name1` AS bezug,
          '' AS zeit_benutzer,
          REPLACE(s.`EK-Kalk`, '.', ',') AS preis_alt_ek,
          REPLACE(s.`Kundenpreis`, '.', ',') AS preis_neu_kunde,
          s.`Prozent von EK-Kalk` || '%' AS abweichung,
          'same' AS richtung
        FROM sonderpreise s
        INNER JOIN changed_articles c ON c.`Artikel-Nr.` = s.`Artikel-Nr.`
        WHERE TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.`Kundenpreis`, '.', ''), ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) <> 0
      )
      SELECT
        '[' || artnr || '] ' || bezeichnung AS AID,
        eintrag AS 'Eintrag',
        bezug AS 'Lieferant / Kunde',
        zeit_benutzer AS 'Zeitpunkt / Benutzer',
        preis_alt_ek AS 'Preis alt / EK-Kalk',
        preis_neu_kunde AS 'Preis neu / Kundenpreis',
        abweichung AS 'Änderung / Spanne',
        richtung AS 'Änderungsrichtung',
        artnr AS '__Artikelnummer',
        row_type AS '__Typ',
        row_time AS '__Zeit'
      FROM combined
      ORDER BY __Artikelnummer ASC, __Typ ASC, __Zeit DESC NULLS LAST, bezug ASC
